note: Per-ISO calibration-complete markers gating the holdout quarantine (CLAUDE.md rule 22, amended 2026-07-06 — docs/handoffs/holdout-policy-memo-2026-07.md §(e), Option 2 DECIDED). Rule 22 splits two channels: (1) DATA INTAKE for any out-of-training year (2018, 2019, ≤2021, 2022, H1-2026) is allowed any time, for any ISO, under explicit session-logged owner authorization, validated no-LP only (byte-identity / loader-resolvability checks — never a dispatch solve) — see `intake_log` below; it does NOT require an entry in `complete`. (2) SOLVE, SCORE, and DASHBOARD REGISTRATION of any out-of-training year remain under FULL quarantine until the ISO appears in `complete`. Declaring an ISO complete authorizes the ONE-SHOT holdout validation: solve the frozen keeper config once per holdout window on already-intaken data, record the result whatever it is, and never re-tune against it. CI (scripts/legitimacy_diagnostics.py --keepers, scripts/audit_keepers.py) FAILS any registered bundle carrying a solve year outside 2023-2025 for an ISO not marked here; `run_calibration_full.py` hard-fails a bare `--year` outside 2023-2025 without both `--holdout-authorized` and a `complete` marker. Marker format: "<ISO>": {"declared": "YYYY-MM-DD", "keeper": "<run id frozen for the one-shot score>", "by": "<session/owner>"}.
